changelog: Search: the sidebar now finds chats by the prompts you typed, and shows the matching prompt under the chat title. Replies, thinking, tool calls and generated code are never indexed.
Pets: Settings → Pets with Gemmy and 7 friends (Kitsu, Frost, Beep, Mochi, Cinder, Mist, Lotl), each with its own reactions, signature move and favourite treat.
Agent control: on/off switches for each skill, MCP server and plugin of Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode.
Chat pages: web pages in chat can be multi-file sites (HTML, CSS, JS) or a saved page, and the new /playground command makes live HTML/CSS/JS pages.
IDE: Markdown files open as a formatted preview and can switch back to the source; saving keeps file permissions, and moving a folder into its parent no longer deletes it.

Security & stability: plugins ask before install/update, backups and crash reports leave out secrets, added a Phone tools key, fixed SSL errors and crashes on Android 7/7.1, and wireless debugging now turns off after 10 idle minutes.

Fixes carried from upstream: OpenCode chat export/share, Claude Code losing the last reply line, subagent chats grouped under their parent, termux-tts first-text silence, and wrong voice-message playback.
All fork features are preserved: floating system overlay with resize/depth/icon controls, Notes sync protection, Android automation upgrades, jev_mcp and the persistent signed release pipeline.
